_doc: Every resource (PLAN §2, ROAST 2.5). `kind`: raw (dug or cut) | refined (made) | arcane (M6). `colour` is the scope/ledger tint. `sources` say which cell materials a camp or drill takes a raw from: an ore cell's `amt` byte counts lumps of `unitsPerAmt` units (§3.1), so a camp lifts one lump at a time and the cell's amt falls by one; at zero the cell becomes `becomes`. A tree cell has no amt: cutting it gives `yield` units at once. Order of `list` is the ledger/stores order; append new rows at the end.

list.name: Food
list._note: M7: farms and fisheries make it, houses eat it

list.name: Water
list._note: M7: wells draw it, houses drink it

list.name: Refined mana
list._m6: made by the mana refinery inside the HQ yard ring; js/sim/mana pours it into the HQ mana store while there is room (it waits in jars when the store is full)

crystal._m6: crystal clusters grow back while any crystal cell is left (js/sim/mana/crystals.js)

deposits._doc: Shallow deposits under the ground (§3.1 records, not cells). Counts are for a Normal map and scale with map area. Revealed only by a survey thumper pulse. `amt` is units.
